render_note: The production rule (eq-1) is fully page-verified. The turn angle and scale factor R are not given as explicit numeric values on this page (R is a symbolic parameter throughout; the branching angle is implicit in Figure 8.5's own rendering, not stated as a number in the surrounding text). The render therefore uses standard, commonly-published L-system parameters for this exact structure class (symmetric branching, angle ~25-30 degrees, R~0.7 scale-down per level) rather than a corpus-extracted numeric value — stated explicitly here, not silently assumed, matching the same disclosure pattern used for the Barnsley/Sierpinski IFS fixture.
